        std::cin.tie(nullptr);

long long fill_value = -1;

void fill3D(long long arr[][][]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 10001; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 25; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < 11; k++)
                arr[i][j][k] = -1;
}

void fill2D(long long arr[][]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 10001; i++)

            arr[i][j] = -1;

long long go(const std::string &A, int i, int pv, int v) {
    if (i == (int)A.size()) {
        return (pv == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (dp[i][pv][v] != fill_value)
        return dp[i][pv][v];
    long long ans = 0;
    if (A[i] == '_') {
        for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
            if (i == 0 && j == 0)
                continue;
            int y = (pv * 10 + j) % 25;
            ans += go(A, i + 1, y, v);
        }
    } else if (A[i] == 'X') {
        if (v != 10) {
            ans += go(A, i + 1, (pv * 10 + v) % 25, v);
        } else {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                if (i == 0 && j == 0)
                    continue;
                int y = (pv * 10 + j) % 25;
                ans += go(A, i + 1, y, j);
            }
        }
    } else {
        int digit = A[i] - '0';
        ans += go(A, i + 1, (pv * 10 + digit) % 25, v);
    }
    return dp[i][pv][v] = ans;
}
